Sodium 138 mmol/L, Potassium 4.2 mmol/L, Chloride 102 mmol/L, Bicarbonate 22 mmol/L, BUN 6 mg/dL, Creatinine 0.2 mg/dL, Glucose 78 mg/dL, Calcium 9.4 mg/dL, AST 28 U/L, ALT 22 U/L

Negative for bacterial growth after 48 hours
No pathogens detected (including Salmonella, Shigella, Campylobacter, E. coli O157:H7, rotavirus, norovirus, adenovirus)
Opening pressure 12 cm H₂O, WBC 2/μL (all lymphocytes), RBC 0/μL, glucose 62 mg/dL, protein 24 mg/dL, Gram stain negative, viral PCR panel (HSV-1, HSV-2, enterovirus, parechovirus) negative
No evidence of intussusception, volvulus, or intra-abdominal mass; bowel wall thickness normal; no free fluid; appendix non-dilated and non-hyperemic
Bilateral hip joints normal; acetabular angles within age-appropriate limits; no effusion or synovitis
